race.description: Ladbrokes Tote Win +5% In Nov Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: PERFECT NIGHT (5) should be ready now after two nice runs and then a trial. The way she finished off first up suggests this and even further is what she needs. JUST MY LOT (10) just never runs you a bad race. She will plant herself right with the leaders or in front. The winkers go on now. THE QUIET IMMORTAL (1) is another who gives you a sight each and every time. Gets help under the big weight with Kennedy's 3kg claim, though the wide draw will require a clever ride. SHADES OF STARDOM (6) finished a distant third when resuming at the Bool but is sure to have come on from that and has won here before. Keeping in mind.
